params.caption: 🕹️ Roblox refuses to refund $20K a 9-year-old spent A Halifax child ran up about $28,000 CAD in in-game purchases on a shared Apple Pay account. Most companies reversed their charges, but Roblox – roughly $20,000 of the total – declined, saying the purchases were made via a third party and pointing the family to the merchant. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 19:34 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @Roblox 👍 or 👎 – should Roblox refund it? · 💬 Comment your take #Roblox #ParentalControls #ApplePay #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
